div.div:
Use the explicit trio when you cache data (config, a callout result, a token) not the whole response, need to invalidate on a write (POST/PUT/DELETE), or want a key that is not request-shaped.
Key rules: include everything that changes the answer (tenant, version, locale) and nothing that does not.
